Players Committee card image of [[Aurra Sing With Blaster Rifle]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “Permanent weapon is •Aurra Sing's Blaster Rifle (may target a character for free; if targeting a Jedi, draw two destiny, otherwise draw destiny; target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if total destiny +1 > defense value).” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/a5142dd/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual12-Dark/large/aurrasingwithblasterrifle.gif Images-HT/starwars/Virtual12-Dark/large/aurrasingwithblasterrifle.gif] as of commit a5142dd “Tweak set images” (12 May 2020).
